en.bdb: No liberation without the perfect Guru  ''

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਣ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਵਰਨੁ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan kar varatiaa varan chihan kih nadhar na aaiaa|

en.bdb: That Lord is diffused in all the four varnas, but , His own colour and mark are imperceptible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀਆਂ ਦਰਸਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia dharasan bhekhadhaareeaa(n) dharasan vich na dharasan paiaa|

en.bdb: The followers of the six philosophical orders (of India) could not see Him in their philosophies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਦਸ ਨਾਵ ਧਰਿ ਨਾਉ ਗਣਾਇ ਨ ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)niaasee dhas naav dhar naau ganai na naau dhiaaiaa|

en.bdb: Sannyasis giving ten names to their sects, counted His many names but donnot contemplate the Nam.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਲ ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: raaval baareh pa(n)th kar gurmukh pa(n)th na alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: Ravals (yogis) made their twelve sects but the imperceptible way of the gurmukhs could not be known by them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀਏ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bahu roopee bahu roope'ee roop na rekh na lekh miTaiaa|

en.bdb: The mimics assumed many forms but even then they could not wipe out the writ (inscribed by the Lord) i.e. they could not attain liberation from transmigration.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਚਲਦੇ ਸੰਗ ਲਖ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: mil mil chaladhe sa(n)g lakh saadhoo sa(n)g na ra(n)g ra(n)gaiaa|

en.bdb: Though millions of people move jointly creating various leagues and sects but they also could not dye their minds in the (steadfast) colour of holy congregation.
Without the perfect Guru, they all are infatuated by maya.
